Chilaka Sai Manoj Kumar Reddy Adobe Workfront Administrator

saimanoj6919@gmail.com +91 6300581382

Professional Summary Experienced Adobe Workfront System Administrator with 4+ years of expertise in implementing, managing, and optimizing Workfront systems to support organizational goals. Proficient in workflow configuration, Custom Forms, report creation, and user training to enhance team productivity. Providing system support to diverse stakeholders.

Key Skills

Adobe Workfront Administration • Workflow Design & Optimization • User Permissions & Security • Custom Forms Creations and Calculated Fields • Custom Reporting & Dashboards • • • Project Management Processes • • Managing Request queues • Have Knowledge on Workfront Fusion Troubleshooting & Technical Support

System Configuration & Maintenance

End-User Training & Documentation

Certifications Adobe Workfront Core Developer Certification (September,2024)

Professional Experience

Organization

Designation

Duration

Accenture Solutions

Packaged App Development Analyst

Sep 2021 – Till date

Education Bachelor of Technology (Computer Science and Engineering) from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad in the year 2021.

Work Experience Adobe Workfront System Administrator Client: Roche Duration: September 2021 To till Date

Created Roche Project Workfront platform from scratch as per their requirements. • Configure and manage the Adobe Workfront platform, including system updates, user accounts, and permissions.

Creating Custom forms, calculated fields and updating the forms whenever new changes will occur.

Design and implement custom workflows and templates to streamline project management processes.

Develop and maintain real-time reports, dashboards, and analytics to support decision making across teams.

Provide training and support to over users, enhancing their proficiency with Workfront tools and processes.

• Monitor system performance and address technical issues to ensure high availability and

•

reliability. Supported the implementation of Workfront across [department/organization], customizing it to align with business requirements.

• Collaborated with project teams to define project lifecycles, task assignments, and approval

processes within Workfront.

Conducted workshops and created user manuals to educate teams on best practices and new functionalities.

Delivered ongoing system enhancements based on user feedback and organizational needs. • Creating Request Queues and Implementing Request Queue Changes. • Creation of Topic groups, queue topics, Routing Rules, Teams, Groups, Layout Templates, Access Levels.

Creating Portfolios and Programs. •

Troubleshoot technical Workfront issues and bugs and coordinate with Adobe Workfront technical support when necessary.

Create configuration documentation for all internal changes and updates to the Workfront system.

Conducting regular audits with the teams to clean up the system.

Experience on Fusion Duration: 3+ months

Have experience how to use different modules like Watch Events, Search Record, Read

Record, Update Record, Router, Webhooks, Http. Implemented few scenarios like Project status update based on task statuses, auto updating some date fields and some custom fields, Calculating TAT’s using Fusion, assigning tasks to users, Project auto creation when a request is raised and exploring more to automate Workfront. Troubleshooting if the scenario fails and fixing the scenarios.



• Documenting the implemented scenarios. •

Providing training to users how and when fusion will trigger and implement the scenario in Workfront.

Technical Proficiencies

Adobe Workfront (Admin, Reporting) • • Collaboration Platforms (Microsoft Teams, SharePoint) Project Management Tools (Jira, ServiceNow)
